card.name: Inside drug names like elagolix
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a drug name that is split into parts, most often "ag" in el-ag-olix, also "iv" in pivmecillinam, "riv" in rivastigmine and "v" in elvitegravir. It appears in drug-interaction and dosing text.

modes.label: elagolix
modes.description: The "ag" piece after "el" in elagolix inside interaction tables or warnings.
modes.example: Limit concomitant use of el<<ag>>olix 150 mg once

modes.label: other split drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of other drug names such as pivmecillinam, rivastigmine and elvitegravir.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the next pieces of a partly spelled drug name, such as "garg" or "ivo".
card.plain: It fires partway through certain long drug names, especially elagolix, while the name is still being spelled out.
